title_zh: 比较项链材质和长度后选礼物

scenario.label_zh: 比较礼物项链的材质与长度
scenario.goal_zh: 核对项链材质并借镜子比较长度后选定礼物

context_zh: 顾客根据收礼人的习惯比较两条项链，并借镜子确认长度。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Yasmin
sentences.text: Is the chain on this necklace silver, or is it just silver-coloured?

sentences.speaker: Jeweller
sentences.text: That one is silver. The other is stainless steel and costs less.

sentences.speaker: Yasmin
sentences.text: She usually wears silver, so I will stay with that. Can I compare the two lengths?

sentences.speaker: Jeweller
sentences.text: Certainly. This one is forty centimetres, and this one is forty-five. Here is a mirror.

sentences.speaker: Yasmin
sentences.text: The shorter one sits too high on me. Her neck is about the same size as mine.

sentences.speaker: Jeweller
sentences.text: Would you prefer the longer silver one, then?

sentences.speaker: Yasmin
sentences.text: Yes, please. That is the one I will give her.
